messages:
ryan: Noticing a sharp jump in kv eviction counters after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak. eviction spikes line up with some long-context jobs :thinking_face:
ryan: Pushing the profiling traces now but wanted to flag here first. per-instance evictions look uneven across the fleet.
maria: :eyes: Can you paste the PromQL you're using?
ryan: Sure — quick check I ran in grafana: ```sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (instance)```
ryan: The top 2 instances are 3-5x the median. CPU & memory for those pods look normal though.
lex: Could be fragmentation + increased reuse churn for specific models. Did kernel selector change alter per-seq batching heuristics?
sophie: We did roll a micro-change to batching heuristics that nudges more continuous-batching for >1024 seqs. Might increase KV residency churn.
maria: If batching holds prefixes longer, we might be evicting more fragments due to memory pressure even if overall mem looks fine. Need residency and frag reuse metrics.
ryan: Added a quick PromQL for residency rate: ```sum(kv_cache_resident_fragments) by (model)``` — shows one model with 40% higher residency churn.
lex: Can we correlate to kernel selection logs? I want to see whether those instances switched to the new kernel path more often.
ryan: Uploading a profiling trace link: https://internal-grafana/company/prof/trace/abcd1234 (perf-bot will post trace summary)
perf-bot: Automated profile summary: increased L2 cache misses in KV walker and 22% higher page-fault-like stall events on hot instances.
sophie: OK that points at a memory access pattern regression after kernel change. Suggest: rollback kernel selector for a canary group and collect KV reuse heatmaps.
maria: Dashboard asks: 1) add per-model residency time histogram 2) eviction_per_instance panel scoped by region 3) frag_reuse_ratio metric 4) alert if 5m eviction rate > 0.5x baseline
lex: I'll open a tracking ticket with steps and add a runbook section to check these signals. Also propose a temporary canary policy: kernel_selector=legacy for 10% traffic to compare.
ryan: Thanks — here's a quick query we should add to alert rule drafts: ```sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m])) / sum(kv_cache_resident_fragments) > 0.005```
maria: I'll prototype the residency heatmap (per model x age bucket) and drop it on the runtime dashboards.
sophie: After that we should run the long-context replay harness (10k seqs) against the canary and baseline to measure mem growth over 1h.
lex: Ticket created: https://tracker/internal/RED-7892 — includes profiling trace + suggested dashboard panels + rollback plan. Assigning to eng-runtime oncall.
ryan: TL;DR: eviction spike correlated with kernel-selection change -> likely changed access pattern causing fragmentation and reuse drop. Next: canary rollback, add residency/frag metrics, long-context replay.
maria: Got it. I'll shepherd the dashboard work and the replay job.
lex: I'll drive the canary and rollback if needed.
sophie: Will coordinate the evaluation and verify perf regressions are fixed before re-enabling new kernel selector. :+1:
ryan: Great, thanks everyone.
